All rights reserved.", "tlp": {"label": "WHITE", "url": "https://www.first.org/tlp/"}}, "lang": "en", "notes": [{"category": "summary", "text": "Security update for php8", "title": "Title of the patch"}, {"category": "description", "text": "This update for php8 fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2025-1218: php: php: Denial of Service via out-of-bounds read in mysqlnd wire protocol parser (bsc#1282981).
- CVE-2025-14181: Integer overflow to buffer overflow in soap HTTP parsing (bsc#1283216).
- CVE-2026-6103: Archive entry injection via integer overflow in TAR parser (bsc#1282980).
- CVE-2026-91765: Denial of Service via unbounded recursion in SOAP parser (bsc#1282875).
- CVE-2026-91766: Credential disclosure via cross-origin HTTP redirects (bsc#1282876).
- CVE-2026-91767: Information disclosure via crafted TLS server certificate (bsc#1282877).
- CVE-2026-91768: Access control bypass via partial IPv6 address comparison (bsc#1282878).
- CVE-2026-91769: OpenSSL stream peer verification falls back to the Common Name whenever no `subjectAltName` matches,
  allowing trusted certificate impersonation (bsc#1283044).
- CVE-2026-92842: Information disclosure via out-of-bounds read in stream filters (bsc#1282985).
- CVE-2026-93682: Out-of-bounds read via empty HTTP redirect Location header (bsc#1282986).

Changes for php8:

- Updated to version 8.2.34
